# B2B LinkedIn Review Pack

## Alternative 1

Your customers already know how to use WhatsApp.

Now your product can let them check a balance, receive assets, or send an approved transaction there—inside your own branded flow.

Relay Pocket’s white-label API adds conversational wallet actions without asking users to learn a new interface.

Built across 60+ blockchain networks.  
12,480 wallet actions completed in the public beta.

## Alternative 2

Adding wallet functionality should not mean adding another destination for users to learn.

With Relay Pocket, fintech and wallet teams can place key wallet actions inside WhatsApp while keeping their own brand in the experience.

Check a balance. Receive assets. Send an approved transaction.

One familiar conversation. More than 60 supported blockchain networks.

## Alternative 3

The best wallet flow may be the one your users do not have to relearn.

Relay Pocket gives product teams a white-label API for bringing wallet actions into WhatsApp, under the partner’s own brand.

That means users can check balances, receive assets, and send approved transactions in a familiar conversational flow.

12,480 completed wallet actions in the public beta—actions, not user accounts.

## First-comment CTAs

1. Building a wallet or fintech flow in WhatsApp? Explore the developer page: relaypocket.example/developers

2. Which wallet action would be most useful for your users in a conversation: balance checks, receiving assets, or approved sends?

## Visual Direction

Use a real WhatsApp-style conversation screen framed by a neutral, partner-branded mobile interface mockup. Show a short sequence: “Check balance” → balance response → “Send” → approval state. Keep branding generic and partner-led; Relay Pocket appears only as a subtle infrastructure cue. Headline: **“Wallet actions, in the conversation your users already know.”**

criterion_results.evidence: El review pack contiene 3 alternativas, 2 CTA y 1 Visual Direction, todos en inglés.
«inside your own branded flow» y «keeping their own brand» hacen protagonista al producto del partner.
Explica la consecuencia como acciones útiles dentro de una conversación familiar.
Usa las cifras públicas y aclara expresamente «actions, not user accounts».
No cruza ningún dato privado del memo.
Voz específica y contenida, sin FOMO, superlativos ni promesas financieras.
Las alternativas sostienen una consecuencia central; un CTA enlaza y el otro formula una pregunta de tres opciones.
Pide usar una pantalla real y mockup neutral, con Relay Pocket sólo como «subtle infrastructure cue».
